svg.title: Provincial out-of-country hospital caps versus a private travel medical maximum
svg.desc: Published daily public hospital caps are tens or hundreds of Canadian dollars. A private travel medical certificate is the layer that addresses the unpaid balance, evacuation, and drugs.
svg.text: Public daily caps, not the hospital bill
Canadian dollars per day. Ministry pages used 23 Sep 2026.
Bars show the public per diem only. Evacuation, repatriation, and most foreign drugs sit outside these caps.
Private travel medical is the contract for the unpaid balance. Read the maximum and the stability clause.
RAMQ example: 3 hospital days can reimburse $300 against a much larger U.S. bill. Education only.
